identity.display_name: J.T. Holub / James Holub Equine Services

source_evidence.title: James Holub Equine Services - Homepage
source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: As a professional farrier I've dedicated my career to continuing my education... My preference is to emphasize the basic fundamentals to properly 'balance' the equine digit... I believe it is this emphasis of focusing on the trim and proper shoe placement that allows me to keep most of the horses in my care working to the best of their ability with just four plain shoes.

source_evidence.source_name: James Holub Equine Services - Travel section
source_evidence.title: James Holub Equine Services - Travel section
source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: While I mainly work between Wellington, Fl and Lexington, KY I'm capable of traveling to just about anywhere.

source_evidence.source_name: James Holub Equine Services - Lameness section
source_evidence.title: James Holub Equine Services - Lameness section
source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Your equine athletes work hard. And while I feel the best way to deal with lameness is to do everything possible to prevent it in the first place... My intention is to utilize every aspect of my continued education to get your horse sound as soon as possible so both of you can go back to work.

source_evidence.source_name: James Holub Equine Services - Glue-On Shoes section
source_evidence.title: James Holub Equine Services - Glue-On Shoes section
source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: I've been successfully applying Polyflex, Sigafoos, and Direct Glue Aluminum shoes for over a decade.

source_evidence.source_name: James Holub Equine Services - About page
source_evidence.title: James Holub Equine Services - About page
source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: After growing up around Thoroughbreds and handling race horses for most of his early life, in 2003 J.T. attended Casey & Son's Farrier School in Resaca, GA. After graduating he served an apprenticeship in Ocala, Florida with a farrier that focused on therapeutic shoeing. Following his apprenticeship J.T. went on to be a licenced track farrier at Presque Isle Downs, Mountaineer Racetrack, and Thistledown for 5 years... J.T. moved to Kentucky to focus on shoeing upper level sport horses... he continues to follow the major show jumping and dressage circuits from Kentucky to Wellington and abroad developing hoofcare solutions for sport horses at the highest levels of competition.

source_evidence.source_name: James Holub Equine Services - Contact page
source_evidence.title: James Holub Equine Services - Contact page
source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Farrier: J.T. Holub | 440.522.2995 | P.O. Box 13111 Lexington, KY 40583 | holubfarrierltd@gmail.com

criteria.notes: Website states 'As a professional farrier', describes active hoof-care practice including therapeutic shoeing, lameness evaluation, and glue-on shoe application. About page confirms farrier school (Casey & Son's 2003), apprenticeship, 5 years as licenced track farrier, and current sport horse practice since 2013.

criteria.criterion_label: Uses or influences the purchase of professional hoof-care products
criteria.notes: States use of Polyflex, Sigafoos, and Direct Glue Aluminum shoes. As a professional farrier applying shoes and hoof-care products daily, plausibly uses or influences hoof-care product purchasing. Direct evidence of specific product usage (glue-on shoe types) confirms professional product engagement.
Website refers to 'the horses in my care' and mentions following show jumping/dressage circuits with clients, but no explicit count of clients, horses served, or farms/operations served is stated.

criteria.criterion_label: Regular appointments and established business activity
criteria.notes: Describes active professional practice with travel between Wellington FL and Lexington KY, following major show jumping and dressage circuits. References ongoing shoeing of 'upper level sport horses' and 'horses in my care'. Business has current contact page with PO Box and active email/phone.

PO Box in Lexington, KY (heart of Kentucky horse country, high-equine-activity area). Also reports working between Wellington FL (major winter equestrian hub) and Lexington KY (spring/summer/fall hub). Explicitly mentions Tryon and Spruce Meadows as reachable destinations.

Specialises in therapeutic shoeing, lameness evaluation and solutions, quarter crack repair, laminitis solutions, and glue-on shoe applications (Polyflex, Sigafoos, Direct Glue Aluminum). Describes work with conformation defects and severe hoof issues.

Graduated Casey & Son's Farrier School (2003), served apprenticeship with therapeutic farrier, held licensed track farrier status at three racetracks for 5 years, worked in podiatry department at Hagyard's Equine Institute. Attended multiple clinics and conferences including NE Association of Equine Practitioner Symposiums and International Hoofcare Summit.

criteria.criterion_label: Works with sport or competition horses
criteria.notes: After 2013 moved to Kentucky to focus on shoeing upper level sport horses. Follows major show jumping and dressage circuits (Kentucky, Wellington, abroad). Homepage references 'Your equine athletes' and focuses on keeping horses 'back in the ring'.
No evidence of multiple Farriers. Contact page lists only J.T. Holub as Farrier. Business name 'James Holub Equine Services' and single-person practice described throughout.

As the primary (apparently sole) Farrier who selects and applies hoof-care products (glue-on shoes, shoes, nails) and makes clinical decisions about what products to use for each horse, has direct purchasing influence. Specific mention of selecting between Polyflex, Sigafoos, and Direct Glue Aluminum demonstrates product selection authority.

criteria.criterion_label: Strong fit with professional hoof-care products
criteria.notes: Professional farrier applying shoes, glue-on attachments, and therapeutic hoof-care solutions daily. Regular professional need for horseshoes, nails, adhesives, and related hoof-care products aligned with Equinet's range.

Currently active with an operational website, current contact page with active email/phone, follows major show jumping and dressage circuits. Website is a Squarespace site (implies active maintenance). Attended NE Association of Equine Practitioner Symposiums and International Hoofcare Summit (dated but shows professional engagement trajectory).

criteria.notes: Candidate is a fully established professional farrier with ~23 years of experience. Not an apprentice or junior entrant.
